headline: Senegal: Senegal's Exports - A 4.4% Increase Recorded in June 2026
summary: Senegal's exports reached 524.7 billion FCFA in June 2026, up from 502.8 billion FCFA in the previous month. The month-on-month increase was 4.4%.
why: Export values are a core indicator of an economy's external trade and foreign currency earnings. Senegal's economy is closely watched by investors in West African sovereign and regional debt.
